title: GTA 6 Details Are So Vast No Employee Knows It All
description: Recent reports highlight that Rockstar's games are so detailed no single employee knows everything, explaining features like RDR2's shrinking horse testicles.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Vast Detail of Rockstar Games: Why No Single Employee Knows It All

In the history of open-world gaming, Rockstar Games has consistently stood out for its extreme dedication to detail. Recent reporting from gaming media outlet Eurogamer reveals a fascinating aspect of this development culture: the worlds are so intricate and filled with countless moving parts that no single employee knows every single detail contained within them.

While we look ahead to the highly anticipated release of GTA 6, this underlying culture of allowing developers to pack their games with micro-details offers a glimpse into how these massive virtual worlds are actually built.

## The Origin of Red Dead Redemption 2's Famous Horse Testicles

To understand this development philosophy, one can look back at Red Dead Redemption 2. One of the most infamous and iconic examples of the game's extraordinary level of detail is the realistic animation of horse testicles—which dynamically contract in cold weather and expand again in the warmth.

Interestingly, media reports indicate that this feature was never mandated by Rockstar management. It did not originate from a mandatory list of features that needed to be added to the cowboy epic. Instead, these infamous horse physics were the unexpected, autonomous work of one person or a group of people working independently on the project.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's unique environment of allowing developers the freedom to implement autonomous touches is what gives their worlds a living, breathing quality. When creators are empowered to add details simply out of passion rather than a checklist, masterpieces are born. We can only expect a similar philosophy to drive the hidden wonders waiting for players in GTA 6.
